reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is correct. Gossip path validates index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS via verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:356). Sync path (request_manager.nim:190, validator_custody.nim:168) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof which omits index validation. When put() adds sidecars to ColumnQuarantine (blob_quarantine.nim:320), it calls getIndex(sidecar.index) which does indexMap[int(index)] without bounds check. indexMap is sized to NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS=128 (blob_quarantine.nim:830). An attacker can trigger this via sync request by responding with data_column_sidecar.index >= 128, causing out-of-bounds array access and crash. Spec reference: 01e file outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 209-224 requires 'sidecar.index must be in range [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS) to be accepted.' Target is Nimbus-eth2 with ~10-20% network share per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE deployment context. Single malicious peer can crash affected nodes via sync response. Severity: Medium per bug bounty scope (crash affects >5% network).
